title: J030--Diesel Generator Service
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > 242-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 02 (36C242)
description:
Sources Sought Notice

This Sources Sought is issued by the VISN 2 Contracting Office for the purpose of collecting information related to diesel generator service for the James J. Peters VA Medical Center in Bronx, NY. The NAICS code identified for this requirement is 811310, with a size standard of $12.5 million.  The requirement is detailed in the attached Statement of Work. 
This is a Sources Sought Notice. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this Sources Sought or to otherwise pay for the information solicited. Although "proposal," "offeror," contractor, and "offeror" may be used in this sources sought notice, any response will be treated as information only. It shall not be used as a proposal. The Government is seeking information for market research purposes only.
Any information received from a contractor in response to this Sources Sought may be used in creating a solicitation. Any information received which is marked with a statement, such as "proprietary" or "confidential," intended to restrict distribution will not be distributed outside of the Government, except as required by law. 

Part of the purpose of this sources sought is to determine the viability of set aside to a specific socio-economic category (service-disabled veteran owned small business, veteran owned small business, women owned small business, HUB Zone, 8(a), small business). 
Interested parties MUST provide: 
Company/individual name
Address
Point of contact
capability statement
Examples of same or similar work performed at other facilities, include contract numbers and subcontractors for those jobs if applicable.
SAM UEID number (for Prime and Subcontractor, if applicable)
Any applicable Federal Supply Schedules
If your intention is to subcontract work, what tasks will be performed by the subcontractor due to your inability to perform them within your company? 
If your intention is to subcontract work, what tasks will be performed by you as the prime contractor?
Proof of any applicable certifications or training. Please indicate whether the certified individuals are employed by the prime or sub contractor. 
Any relevant comments about the Attachment(s) 

Contractors that are able to meet the requirements in the attachment and possess an interest in performing this service, are encouraged to email the above information to Chris Weider at Christopher.Weider@va.gov. 
If any of the requested information is not supplied with the response, the contractor may not be considered in the Government s Procurement Strategy.
